grants.title: Science of Learning and Augmented Intelligence (SL)
grants.summary: Funds basic research on human learning and augmented intelligence technologies to improve learning processes. Targeted at researchers and academic institutions.
grants.eligibility: U.S. higher education institutions and non-profit research organizations.
grants.requirements: Fundamental cognitive science or artificial intelligence research on human learning mechanisms.

grants.title: Community-Based Participatory Research to Advance Data and Practice Transformation (ADAPT) for Optimizing Oral Health for All (UG3/UH3 Clinical Trial Optional)
grants.summary: Funds community-based participatory research to transform oral health data practices and care delivery. Aimed at non-profit research organizations and academic institutions.
grants.eligibility: Higher education institutions, non-profits, and research organizations eligible for NIH grants.
grants.requirements: Conduct participatory research to optimize oral healthcare delivery and data systems.

grants.title: Notice of Intent to Publish a FOA for Impact of Technology and Digital Media Exposure Usage on Child and Adolescent Development
grants.summary: Notifies potential applicants of an upcoming opportunity to study how digital media and technology exposure impact child and adolescent development. Targeted at academic research institutions.
grants.eligibility: Higher education institutions, non-profit research institutes, and research organizations.
grants.requirements: Investigate physical, cognitive, and psychosocial developmental impacts of digital technology exposure in youth.

grants.title: Implementation and Evaluation of Databases to Examine AIDS
grants.summary: Funds the creation, implementation, and evaluation of data platforms and databases to advance HIV/AIDS surveillance and research. Target applicants are research institutions and international health networks.
grants.eligibility: Higher education institutions, public health organizations, and non-profit research entities worldwide.
grants.requirements: Implement, harmonize, and evaluate data platforms for HIV/AIDS epidemiological and clinical research.

grants.title: Novel Approaches to Advance Precision Aging and Cognitive Health
grants.summary: Funds innovative research strategies to support precision diagnostic and therapeutic solutions for cognitive health and aging. Aimed at academic health centers and specialized research organizations.
grants.eligibility: Universities, non-profit research institutions, and medical centers.
grants.requirements: Develop precision approaches to track, prevent, or treat cognitive decline in aging populations.

grants.title: Maternal and Child Health Encounters Networks (MCHEK)
grants.summary: Funds data networks to track and analyze healthcare encounters for maternal and child health populations. Aimed at public health agencies, non-profits, and US healthcare institutions.
grants.eligibility: Domestic public and private non-profit entities, state health agencies, and academic centers.
grants.requirements: Develop data networks to monitor healthcare access, quality, and outcomes for mothers and children.

grants.title: Advancing Bioinformatics, Translational Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Research (R01 Clinical Trial Optional)
grants.summary: This grant funds research projects in bioinformatics, translational bioinformatics, and computational biology. It targets researchers and institutions developing novel computational methods and tools for biomedical data.
grants.eligibility:
Higher education institutions, non-profits, and research organizations.
Foreign components and non-US organizations may be eligible.
grants.requirements:
Develop and apply innovative bioinformatics or computational biology algorithms.
Demonstrate scientific rigor and biomedical relevance to NIH priorities.

grants.title: NIAMS P30 Centers Program (P30 - Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
grants.summary: This grant funds institutional core centers to support research infrastructure in arthritis, musculoskeletal, and skin diseases. It targets established US academic and research institutions with active research programs in these fields.
grants.eligibility:
US academic and research institutions with existing NIAMS funding.
Not open to non-US prime organizations.
grants.requirements:
Provide shared resources, core facilities, and administrative structure for NIAMS researchers.
Enhance multidisciplinary research productivity across center projects.

grants.title: HEAL Initiative: Optimization of Therapeutic Medical Devices through Team Science Mechanistic Research (RM1)
grants.summary: This grant funds team science research to optimize therapeutic medical devices for pain management and addiction. It targets multi-disciplinary research teams developing or refining hardware-based device interventions.
grants.eligibility:
Academic research institutions, non-profits, and healthcare organizations.
Team science proposals requiring interdisciplinary expertise.
grants.requirements:
Conduct mechanistic research on therapeutic medical devices for pain or substance use disorders.
Optimize device parameters through team science approaches.

grants.title: Single Source: Scalable and Systematic Neurobiology of Psychiatric and Neurodevelopmental Disorder Risk Genes: Data Resource and Administrative Coordination Center (U24 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
grants.summary: This grant funds a centralized data resource and administrative coordination center for research on risk genes in psychiatric and neurodevelopmental disorders. It targets a pre-selected single source institution.
grants.eligibility: Single-source solicitation restricted to a designated applicant organization.
grants.requirements: Manage scientific coordination and centralized data resources for neurobiological risk gene research.

grants.title: Immune Drivers of Autoimmune Disease
grants.summary: This grant funds fundamental immunological research to identify immune system drivers of autoimmune diseases. It targets basic science and clinical researchers in immunology.
grants.eligibility: Higher education institutions, research institutes, and non-profit research entities worldwide.
grants.requirements:
Investigate cellular and molecular immune mechanisms triggering autoimmune conditions.
Provide preliminary data and experimental rationale.

grants.title: Continuation of the Exceptional Longevity Data Management and Coordinating Center (EL DMCC) (U24 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
grants.summary: This grant funds the ongoing operation of the Data Management and Coordinating Center for exceptional longevity studies. It targets the incumbent or specialized research institutions managing long-term aging cohorts.
grants.eligibility: Continuation solicitation for specialized data management centers in longevity research.
grants.requirements: Provide ongoing data infrastructure, harmonization, and coordination for exceptional longevity cohorts.
